evidence: scripts/issue825_fit_cells.py:1307-1324 (_apply_gates: 'if not g3_pass and not args.smoke and not _eps_smoke(): raise SystemExit(3)'; M_instruct_assistant_chat is in CELLS8, dispatch.sh:22); scripts/issue825_onpolicy_dispatch.sh phase order: [phase=fit] line 196 precedes [phase=upload2] line 283; no trap/failure-sentinel on this path. Plan v7 hard-req 9: 'UPLOAD-2 ... runs BEFORE any binding-gate evaluation — every FAILURE path is upload-then-exit'. Fix: defer the in-process G1/G3 halt to the post-upload wrapper gate block (compute + write g3_gate.json in-fit; evaluate/halt at [phase=gate]) — the same pattern already used for the anchor/wiring gates. summary: Summarizer computes cell_label/support_summary BEFORE audit_pass; an audit-failing cell enters headline support as 'supported' instead of the plan-registered observational flag
evidence: scripts/issue825_onpolicy_summarize.py: cell_label assigned at 225-233 and support_summary appended at 234-244 from ridge/MLP logic only; audit_pass computed AFTER at 248, stored only as audit.headline_eligible (287); parent_delta_table (326-336) carries the unaudited cell_label; wrapper gate phase only PRINTS audit flags (dispatch.sh ~510-527). Plan v7 line 42: pretrained/chat 'enters the HEADLINE only if its audit passes; on audit FAIL it is reported as degenerate-provenance — observational, never a misleading bar'; hard-req 3: 'A failing cell still runs + persists, flagged observational'. Fix: compute audit_pass before labels; audit-fail => cell_label='degenerate-provenance — observational', excluded from support_summary/headline parent-delta support. Note ridge_supported includes any_frozen_r2_positive, so a degenerate low-diversity cell with mechanically inflated R2 is a live path into 'supported'.
